desc.zh-Hans: 长春轨道交通是服务于吉林省长春市的轨道交通系统。其目前拥有6条地铁线路，3条轻轨线路和2条公交线路。2026年长春将开通7号线、5号线，并对1号线和3号线进行南延工作。2027年初预计开通9号线，9号线开通后，长春市民将可乘坐地铁前往龙嘉机场
desc.en: Changshun Rail Transit is the system service in Changchun city, Jinlin province, it has 6 metro lines，3 light rail lines and 2 bus lines. In 2026, Changchun Rail Transit will operate Line 7, Line 5 and extend Line 1 and Line 3. In 2027 Changchun metro line 9 will start operate, which can let people taking the metro to Changchun Longjia International Airport.
